page.layout: One printed page: a single column of text, with no notes in either margin. Running head at top with page number at top right. Signature mark at the foot right. The right side of the scan is the book's edge and binding.

main_text.l: XI. Bas si fuero nactus, nō dubito, quin breui ad
vos rediturus sim.
XII. Sin autem: sed plura nō scribam, ne te mae-
stum iam, prob dolor, ante satis, magis excruciem.
XIII. Ex primis verò, vel ad summum secundis
literis, quid spei sit reliquum, intelligere potero.
XIIII. Itaq; primo quoq; tempore ad me, opta-
tissime ac suauissime parens scribes: & ex me omnes
nostros salutabis, quibus, quo minus scribam, incre-
dibilis dolor facit.
XV. Et hæ ipsæ lituræ, quas meis in literis depre-
hendis, lachrymis factæ, tristitiæ meæ testes esse po-
terunt.
Posterioris generis exemplum erit lib.
11. epistol. 12. in qua Cicero apud Cassium
de rei bene cōtra Antonium gerendæ, ne-
glecta occasione, conqueritur; sed mode-
ste & personæ facta commutatione: ne Cas-
sium offendat. Absoluitur ea primū Exor-
dio, quòd institutæ querelæ causas & oc-
casiones continet. Deinde querela ipsa,
admodū artificiosè tectèq; facta: cùm non
se Cicero in Bruto aut Cassio aliquid de-
siderare: sed populū rumusculis quibus-
dam alium fieri quotidie, & de Cassij atq;
Bruti conqueri timiditate ac negligentia
scribit. Postremò conclusione [illegible, ~8
letters] adhortatoria, ne quid committant, vt iu-

page.notes: Doubtful: "Bas" in XI (possibly "Eas"), and "de-siderare" (long s read as f in the scan). A small printed ornament stands in the right margin beside the XV line; it is not text. The Greek word after "conclusione" is too unclear to read, so it is marked illegible. No catchword is printed. Text continues past the foot of the page ("iu-").
